s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

aluminum_processed_from_us_metal.label: Aluminum smelted and cast in the United States

aluminum_primary_smelted_or_cast_russia.label: Any primary aluminum smelted in Russia or article cast in Russia

privileged_ftz_before_20230410.label: Privileged foreign status before April 10, 2023 at 00:01 Eastern

s232_auto_approved_us_content.label: Reporting decision represents Commerce-approved U.S. automobile content, not a non-automobile article
s232_auto_approved_us_content.description: Heading 9903.94.02 applies to: (i) all entries of articles classifiable under provisions of the HTSUS enumerated in subdivision (b) of this note, but that are not passenger vehicles (sedans, sport utility vehicles, crossover utility vehicles, minivans, and cargo vans) and light trucks; as well as (ii) the U.S. content of passenger vehicles and light trucks described in subdivision (d) of this note, upon approval from the Secretary of Commerce.

s232_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: Actual passenger-vehicle/light-truck parts eligible for USMCA, excluding knock-down kits and compilations
s232_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.description: Heading 9903.94.06 applies to all entries of articles classifiable under provisions of the HTSUS enumerated in subdivision (g) of this note or meeting the requirements of subdivision (p) of this note (i) that are eligible for special tariff treatment under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), other than automobile knock-down kits or parts compilations; or (ii) that are not parts of passenger vehicles (sedans, sport utility vehicles, crossover utility vehicles, minivans, and cargo vans) and light trucks.

s232_usmca_mhd_parts_not_kits.label: Actual medium/heavy-duty vehicle parts eligible for USMCA, excluding knock-down kits and compilations
s232_usmca_mhd_parts_not_kits.description: Heading 9903.74.10 applies to all entries of articles classifiable under provisions of the HTSUS enumerated in subdivision (i) of this note or meeting the requirements of subdivision (j) of this note that qualify for preferential tariff treatment under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), other than medium- and heavy-duty vehicle knock-down kits or parts compilations.

privileged_ftz_before_20250604.label: Privileged foreign status before June 4, 2025 at 00:01 Eastern
privileged_ftz_before_20250604.description: Except as provided in headings 9903.81.98 or 9903.81.92, derivative products of iron or steel of the United Kingdom, as specified in subdivisions (s) and (t) of note 16 to this subchapter, admitted to a U.S.foreign trade zone under ‘‘privileged foreign status’’ as defined by 19 CFR 146.41, prior to 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on June 4, 2025

steel_processed_from_us_metal.label: Steel melted and poured in the United States

s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

aluminum_processed_from_us_metal.label: Aluminum smelted and cast in the United States

aluminum_primary_smelted_or_cast_russia.label: Any primary aluminum smelted in Russia or article cast in Russia

privileged_ftz_before_20230410.label: Privileged foreign status before April 10, 2023 at 00:01 Eastern

s232_auto_approved_us_content.label: Reporting decision represents Commerce-approved U.S. automobile content, not a non-automobile article
s232_auto_approved_us_content.description: Heading 9903.94.02 applies to: (i) all entries of articles classifiable under provisions of the HTSUS enumerated in subdivision (b) of this note, but that are not passenger vehicles (sedans, sport utility vehicles, crossover utility vehicles, minivans, and cargo vans) and light trucks; as well as (ii) the U.S. content of passenger vehicles and light trucks described in subdivision (d) of this note, upon approval from the Secretary of Commerce.

s232_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: Actual passenger-vehicle/light-truck parts eligible for USMCA, excluding knock-down kits and compilations
s232_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.description: Heading 9903.94.06 applies to all entries of articles classifiable under provisions of the HTSUS enumerated in subdivision (g) of this note or meeting the requirements of subdivision (p) of this note (i) that are eligible for special tariff treatment under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), other than automobile knock-down kits or parts compilations; or (ii) that are not parts of passenger vehicles (sedans, sport utility vehicles, crossover utility vehicles, minivans, and cargo vans) and light trucks.

s232_usmca_mhd_parts_not_kits.label: Actual medium/heavy-duty vehicle parts eligible for USMCA, excluding knock-down kits and compilations
s232_usmca_mhd_parts_not_kits.description: Heading 9903.74.10 applies to all entries of articles classifiable under provisions of the HTSUS enumerated in subdivision (i) of this note or meeting the requirements of subdivision (j) of this note that qualify for preferential tariff treatment under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), other than medium- and heavy-duty vehicle knock-down kits or parts compilations.

privileged_ftz_before_20250604.label: Privileged foreign status before June 4, 2025 at 00:01 Eastern
privileged_ftz_before_20250604.description: Except as provided in headings 9903.81.98 or 9903.81.92, derivative products of iron or steel of the United Kingdom, as specified in subdivisions (s) and (t) of note 16 to this subchapter, admitted to a U.S.foreign trade zone under ‘‘privileged foreign status’’ as defined by 19 CFR 146.41, prior to 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on June 4, 2025

steel_processed_from_us_metal.label: Steel melted and poured in the United States

s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.label: Meets Section 122 gn6 civil aircraft
s122_gn6_civil_aircraft.description: (iv) As provided in heading 9903.03.05, the additional duty imposed by heading 9903.03.01 shall not apply to articles the product of any country that are civil aircraft (all aircraft other than military aircraft); their engines, parts and components; their other parts, components and subassemblies; and ground flight simulators and their parts and components, that otherwise meet the criteria of general note 6 of the HTSUS and are classifiable in the following provisions of the HTSUS, but regardless of whether a product is entered under a provision for which the rate of duty “Free (C)” appears in the “Special” sub-column:

s122_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under USMCA
s122_usmca_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.

s122_personal_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

s122_humanitarian_donation.label: Qualifying donation to relieve human suffering
s122_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, such as food, clothing and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering

s122_informational_material.label: Informational material under 9903.03.11
s122_informational_material.description: Articles that are informational materials, including but not limited to publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks and news wire feeds

s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.label: Loaded on vessel and in final transit before Section 122 began
s122_loaded_and_final_transit_before_sta.description: Articles the product of any country that (1) were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit prior to entry into the United States, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026; and (2) are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026

s122_commerce_approved_us_vehicle_conten.label: Commerce-approved U.S. vehicle content under note 33(d)

s122_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: USMCA-eligible auto parts, excluding knock-down kits and parts compilations

s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.label: Section 232-exempt value included in the Chapter 98 dutiable value (USD)
s122_chapter98_section232_overlap_value.description: Reconcile the same value basis. Do not deduct the full article metal or U.S. content from a repairs-only or foreign-assembly value.

s122_content_values_disjoint.label: Exempt content values are distinct, with no double counting

s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under CAFTA_DR
s122_cafta_dr_entered_free.description: Verified originating treatment and actual duty-free entry; eligibility or a modeled utilization share alone is insufficient.
